collab.title: One album, many hands.
collab.lead: You invite your loved ones with a link. Everyone adds their photos and words from their own phone. You put the album together and order it once.
collab.cardSub: In the album above. Click a name to jump to their pages.

steps.title: Invite your loved ones
steps.text: Send a link by message. No account needed to send photos.

steps.title: Everyone adds photos and words
steps.text: Contributions land in your album, with their author's name attached.

steps.title: You compose it and order it
steps.text: You choose the layouts and the pages. One album, one order.

album.title: Iceland, eight days
album.ded: the eight days when the weather changed every ten minutes, and nobody complained.
album.cap1: First waterfall, first fit of laughter.
album.cap3: Black sand beach, wind in our faces.
album.full1: The northern lights weren't on the plan.
album.full2: End of the road, start of the memories.
album.tp1p: We walked two hours across the glacier tongue. Marc lost a glove, Inès found a blue ice cave, Tom filmed the whole thing upside down.
album.tp2p: Forty degrees in the water, six outside. The best moment of the trip, by that evening's show of hands.
album.q1: We drove 1,400 km and had exactly one argument, about the playlist.
album.q2: The northern lights weren't on the plan. They showed up anyway.

album.title: Sarah & Hugo
album.ded: who danced until the very last song.
album.cap2: The bouquet, right before it flew.
album.cap3: Grandpa Jean on the dance floor, of course.
album.full1: The sun waited for the vows to end.
album.tp1p: Julien promised five minutes and took twelve. Nobody checked their watch. The photos come from table 4, who caught it all.
album.tp2p: Three tiers, a strawberry filling, and a candle Grandpa Jean insisted on lighting himself.
album.q1: We wanted a simple wedding. We got a hundred and thirty witnesses to our happiness.
album.q2: Thank you for taking photos for us while we were busy dancing.

album.title: Louise
album.ded: so she knows how much we were waiting for her.
album.cap3: Ten fingers, ten toes, a hat way too big.
album.tp1p: Nights are short, photos are many. Grandma knitted everything, Uncle Léo photographed everything.
album.tp2p: A Tuesday, 7:40am. Dad swears it was for him. Mum has the photo.
album.q1: She holds my finger like she never wants to let go.
album.q2: My grandchildren taught me you can love a little more every day.

album.title: American West
album.ded: rental car, which never broke down. Almost.
album.cap2: Sunrise at 4:50am, for five minutes of magic.
album.cap3: The diner where Yanis ordered the same burger three times.
album.tp1p: We left before everyone else. Chloé shot the cover photo here, phone propped on a rock.
album.tp2p: The road hugged the ocean for 120 miles. We drove with the windows down, quiet for once.
album.q1: The best view was the back seat, with everyone fast asleep.
album.q2: Three weeks, four friends, one trunk. We pulled it off.
